notes:
Summary:
- Prospect: Cobalt builds a regionalized enterprise search product for UK/EU financial institutions. They operate strict residency controls and require deterministic failover between eu-west-1 and eu-west-2 (UK/EU).
- Primary ask: embeddings + reranking pipeline that can index ~2M-20M docs, support low-latency (p90 < 60ms rerank path, <200ms end-to-end for RAG), and predictable per-query cost under current budget.
- Preferences: model transparency, ability to pin model versions and run lightweight rerank models in-region. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for steady throughput and Redwood Private (VPC) for residency. Also wants Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization to reduce per-query cost.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit log retention 7 years, and CMEK/KMS where keys are customer-owned. Legal insists on EU/UK data residency; no cross-border copies for search index backups.
- Quote from Head of Search (call 2026-02-28): "We need sub-100ms rerank latency in-region — anything else is a downgrade to user experience."
- Competitive context: currently evaluating Milvus + custom FAISS rerank vs Pinecone. Elastic used internally for documents but not viable for vector scale + rerank latency.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO wants TCO analysis for 3-year run: if dedicated GPUs with batching and prefix caching reduce token cost by 30% vs current infra, they'll push forward.
- Technical constraints/notes: indexing pipeline uses periodic full refresh every 24h, incremental stream of changes at 1k writes/minute; avg doc length 1.8k tokens; expect embedding dimension 1536; target 50 qps typical with 200 peak.
- Integration: requires S3-compatible storage in EU, integration with customer KMS (Azure Key Vault + HSM potential), and audit hooks for search query logging (redacted PII).
- Sales touches: AE (Maya) intro + 2 tech calls w/ SE (Lars). Security review kickoff 2026-03-03. Pricing ask: EU-only Dedicated pool pricing with cross-region failover allowance.
- Notes style: short bullets in CRM; many action items outstanding.
